name: Ginsen
source:
“...I'll pass.”

Unit: Security Blue, 3rd Squad
Rank: Address

A squad leader who is currently missing. Like other squad leaders, he holds the Address rank and is named after a city (his name is the Japanese spelling of Yinchuan).

Formerly a mercenary, he excels in combat.

To keep others at arm's length, he makes a point of acting blunt and unapproachable.
